# TheHumanInTheLoop Marketplace

> Public catalog of Claude Code and Codex plugins created by Mauricio Perera.

## Purpose

This marketplace publishes reusable Claude Code and Codex plugins, shared skills, workflows, and deterministic validators. It is designed for human-reviewed AI-assisted work.

## Plugin catalog

### Auditor SEO/GEO 2026 (`linter-seo-geo-2026`)

- Description: Content validator for search engines and generative engines with hybrid SEO and GEO pre-publication checks.
- Version: 0.1.0
- Category: Productivity
- Author: Mauricio Perera
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/linter-seo-geo-2026
- Claude marketplace manifest: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/blob/main/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json
- Codex marketplace manifest: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/blob/main/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json

### Marketplace Validator (`marketplace-validator`)

- Description: Validates Claude Code and Codex marketplace manifests, plugin paths, and catalog synchronization.
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/marketplace-validator

### Design System Auditor (`design-system-auditor`)

- Description: Generates and validates DESIGN.md, design-system.json, tokens, components, and hard contracts.
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/design-system-auditor

### Content Fact Checker (`content-fact-checker`)

- Description: Detects verifiable claims and requires named sources, dates, links, and attributions.
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/content-fact-checker

## Installation

In Claude Code, add `MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex` and install `linter-seo-geo-2026@thehumanintheloop-marketplace-claude`. In Codex, register the `.agents/plugins` marketplace and install `linter-seo-geo-2026`. Both platforms consume the same plugin directory and shared skills.

## Source and updates

- Repository: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex
- Catalog: https://mauricioperera.github.io/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/
